name: DeleteExcelWorksheet
label: Delete Excel Worksheet
description: Deletes a specific worksheet from its parent Excel workbook.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object to delete (optional if using Deletion Mode).

fields.name: DeletionMode
fields.label: Deletion Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to identify the worksheet to delete: by Name or Index.

selectOptions.label: Name
selectOptions.description: Deletes the worksheet by its name.

selectOptions.label: Index
selectOptions.description: Deletes the worksheet by its index.

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet to delete (required if 'Deletion Mode' is 'Name').

fields.name: WorksheetIndex
fields.label: Worksheet Index
fields.description: The index of the worksheet to delete (required if 'Deletion Mode' is 'Index').
